verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automated workflows and an AI Editor that creates and modifies ingestion workflows from natural language prompts. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review or approval, or rollback for those automations. Editing a workflow is a related but different capability and earns no credit, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
